title: Football Weekend Recap: Arsenal Win at Anfield, Milan Win the Derby ⚽
description:
Everything you missed from the football weekend (31 Oct – 2 Nov) plus Tuesday's Champions League: Arsenal won 1–0 at Liverpool to go top of the Premier League, Man City lost again, Barcelona hit six, AC Milan beat Inter 3–1, Juventus beat Napoli and Bayern drew 2–2 with Dortmund. Then PSG won 6–0 at Villarreal and Man United came from 2–0 down to beat Roma.

Live scores, fixtures and results: https://scorebuzz.net

#PremierLeague #LaLiga #SerieA #Bundesliga #UCL

title: NFL Week 8 Recap: Vikings Lose, Broncos Stop Mahomes & a ZERO-Completion Win 🏈
description:
Everything you missed from NFL Week 8: the Lions handed the Vikings their first loss, the Broncos stopped Patrick Mahomes on fourth-and-goal, Joe Burrow threw for 462 yards in an overtime win, and the Buccaneers beat the Falcons without completing a pass. Plus every result, the standings and the Week 9 games to watch.

title: NBA & NHL Week in Review: Luka's Scoring Run, Wemby 43 & a Record Comeback 🏀🏒
description:
The NBA and NHL from 28 October to 3 November: Luka Dončić scored 37+ in five straight games, Victor Wembanyama dropped 43, Stephen Curry and SGA both hit 40+, and Memphis's unbeaten start ended in overtime. In the NHL, the Jets came back from 4–0 down in the third, Connor McDavid stretched his record assist streak to 16 and Logan Cooley scored a hat trick with a second left. Standings as of 3 November.

Live scores, fixtures and results: https://scorebuzz.net

#NBA #NHL #Lakers #Spurs #Oilers
